decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot appears to have absorbed the role of the withdrawn standalone de-shuttering robot, so it is now the firm's main robot option and costs little to keep while demand for automation grows.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in an integrated cell, its carrying cost is low, and its value is still unresolved, so the option stays open.
The standalone shuttering robot faces some risk of consolidation into the combined robot, as happened with Product B, but it still serves customers who want a simpler cell, so it is kept for now.
The magazining, cleaning and plotting machine line was launched only in 2024, has several models, and its value is still highly uncertain, so keeping the option is cheap and preserves upside.
The production analysis software has low marginal cost, strengthens the firm's integrated plant and service offer, and is too new to judge, so it is clearly worth keeping.
